acceptance: The seed, the three drawn families and the filler fixture are committed before the scored runs, with an amendment in prereg/.
36 sessions per arm (12 per variant) are reported for full, minus-candidates and the filler arm on one counting model per family.
The share of the drop restored by filler is reported per family with a Holm-corrected test, and the gate outcome is stated.
The phase 3 report has a dated section with the result.
Ledger total is 60 USD or less.
description: Problem: arXiv 2604.11088 reports that random rule files raise task pass rates as much as curated ones. Phase 3's 17 keep results compare the skill with its sections removed; no arm replaced the removed sections with unrelated text of the same length. The checks are behaviour-specific, so presence alone is an unlikely cause, but that was never tested. Outcome: for a sample of keep families, a minus-candidates-plus-filler arm compared with full and minus-candidates. Decision gate, fixed before the runs: pick 3 keep families by seeded random draw, not by hand. If filler restores at least half of the drop on any family (Holm-corrected), report it prominently in the phase 3 report and tell the owner before any further use of the keep results. Otherwise add one dated paragraph stating the result. Guardrails: (1) agents under test run only in /tmp/omp-ablation sandboxes through evals/ablation/run.py or the loading-map probe; (2) do not change ~/.omp/agent/config.yml or ~/.omp/agent/rules while sessions run, and start no run while another evaluation is running; (3) write the pre-registration (hypothesis, arms, checks, sample, decision) and commit it before any scored session; smoke runs never count; (4) use a new out folder and a ledger with the ceiling stated here; stop at the ceiling and report, do not raise it without the owner's approval; (5) read at least 5 transcripts per arm before reporting any number, and report grader faults found; (6) delete or weaken no instruction or skill text on this evidence; (7) correct an existing report with a dated note, never by silently rewriting a published number; (8) scenario and scratch code that is part of the result is committed with it; (9) publish by task branch and draft PR with identity Joe Harris <joeharris76@gmail.com>. Spend ceiling 60 USD. Extra: use the frozen dials in phase3-dials.json unchanged; filler is rule-like prose from an unrelated domain with the same token count within 5%, committed as a fixture; existing phase 3 results keep their scenario hashes.
